steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Continuous fill check
steps.body: Check for frozen or obstructed inlet valve causing continuous water supply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check for frozen or obstructed inlet valve causing continuous water supply.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace inlet valve or clear obstruction.

steps.title: Water level sensor hose
steps.body: If inlet path OK, inspect level sensor hose for fold, cut, or damage. Replace sensor if degraded.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If inlet path OK, inspect level sensor hose for fold, cut, or damage. Replace sensor if degraded.

steps.title: Service inlet valve
steps.oemOutcome: Clear foreign material or replace stuck valve.
